verdict.rationale: Stable pairs its virtual business address with its own registered agent service under the same account. Registered agent locations attach to Company entities and come with automated filing guidance and prefilled forms, so it is a genuine entity-adjacent offering from the same provider. However, none of the story's named services is evidenced: no LLC formation, no lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, and no residency-grade addresses. Missing for 10: LLC/entity formation service, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, residency-grade addresses, independent corroboration of the bundled offering.
